description: This source file contains a PHPUnit test class 'HolidayServiceTest' which tests various functionalities of the 'HolidayService' class in the context of the 'orangehrmLeavePlugin' module. The tests include verifying DAO retrieval, saving holidays, and searching holidays with various filters and recurrence considerations. The test cases utilize mock objects, load test data, and compare expected and actual holiday objects.

classes.name: HolidayServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the 'HolidayService' component within the 'OrangeHRM' project, specifically for leave holiday management features.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, loads configuration, sets up the mock kernel with services, and resets cache.

methods.name: testGetSetHolidayDao
methods.description: Verifies that 'getHolidayDao' returns an instance of 'HolidayDao'.

methods.name: testSaveHoliday
methods.description: Tests saving a Holiday entity via the 'HolidayService'.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysNoneRecurring
methods.description: Tests searching for non-recurring holidays within a date range.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysRecurringCurrentYear
methods.description: Tests searching for holidays with recurring flags in the current year.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysRecurringOtherYear
methods.description: Tests searching with recurring holidays in a different year and comparing results.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysRecurringMultiYear
methods.description: Tests complex multi-year recurring holiday searches across several years.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysRecurringPartYear
methods.description: Tests recurring holidays within a partial year range.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysCheckUniqueness
methods.description: Ensures that holiday search results do not contain duplicates by verifying expected data.
